items.title: vllm-project/vllm v0.32.0
items.snippet: # v0.32.0 ## Highlights This release features 814 commits from 363 contributors (121 new)! * **Structured decisions and generic parsers**: the new `POST /v1/systemone` endpoint answers `choice`, `noul` and `score` questions over a structured state (#59299), is served by default (#60677, #60696), and also runs on `Cloudflare/clef-omni` (#61064), `LiquidAI/d1-3B` (#60676) and DiffusionGemma (#60466)
